mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_batch_participants SET row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,batch_day_id=#{p.batchDayId}, participant_code=#{p.participantCode},full_name=#{p.fullName},date_of_birth=#{p.dateOfBirth},sex=#{p.sex}, identification_number=#{p.identificationNumber},identification_issue_date=#{p.identificationIssueDate}, identification_issue_place=#{p.identificationIssuePlace},ethnicity=#{p.ethnicity},phone=#{p.phone},email=#{p.email}, address=#{p.address},workplace=#{p.workplace},note=#{p.note}, department_name=#{p.departmentName},position_name=#{p.positionName},patient_id=#{p.patientId},prepared_at=#{p.preparedAt},roster_status=#{p.rosterStatus}, attendance_status=#{p.attendanceStatus},actual_examination_date=#{p.actualExaminationDate},attendance_recorded_by=#{p.attendanceRecordedBy}, attendance_recorded_at=#{p.attendanceRecordedAt},attendance_note=#{p.attendanceNote},service_reconciliation_status=#{p.serviceReconciliationStatus}, services_reconciled_by=#{p.servicesReconciledBy},services_reconciled_at=#{p.servicesReconciledAt} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND batch_id=#{p.batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batches b WHERE b.id=#{p.batchId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE OF b)

UPDATE public.health_examination_participant_services s SET row_version=s.row_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,is_performed=v.performed,service_request_id=v.request_id,recorded_by=v.actor,recorded_at=v.recorded_at FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{s.id} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchParticipantId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchServiceId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.isPerformed} AS boolean), CAST(#{s.serviceRequestId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.recordedBy} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.recordedAt} AS timestamptz),CAST(#{s.rowVersion} AS bigint)) ) AS v(id,batch_id,participant_id,service_id,performed,request_id,actor,recorded_at,version) WHERE s.id=v.id AND s.batch_id=v.batch_id AND s.batch_participant_id=v.participant_id AND s.batch_service_id=v.service_id AND s.row_version=v.version
